playstyle: Keep 14 to 18 m behind the line. The interrupt cancels the enemy charge, the weapon buff makes your own line hit harder.

abilities.name: Bind Mark
effects: interrupt: cancels a cast or charge in progress
blocks the next cast for 1.5 s
root 1 s
misses a caster in the last 0.3 s of a charge
abilities.notes: The dedicated interrupt. It deals no damage and never needs any. A 0.3 s cast beats every charge in the game, including a 2.4 s ice charge: the decal stays on the ground and nothing fires. It cannot catch a caster in the last 0.3 s before the release.

abilities.name: Keen Edge
effects: weapon damage raised for 20 s on one ally
stacks three times on the same ally
abilities.notes: The weapon buff. It deals no damage: the block carries the weapon damage bonus, on the INT scale, 12 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 18% at L10, 40% at L40. Cast it on the front line right before the charge lands.

abilities.name: Spark Jab
effects: slow 15% for 1.5 s
abilities.notes: The only damage this class has. Damage 12 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 18 at L10. 3 s cooldown, 6 mana: it exists so the Enchanter can weave between controls without going silent. Never trade on it.

abilities.name: Snare Field
effects: slow 50% for 5 s on entering the field
the field keeps slowing for 8 s
abilities.notes: Ground control. Damage 6 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 9 at L10 on anyone inside the 5 m decal, and the field keeps slowing for 8 s. The decal radius is the spell radius, same rule as the caster lines.

abilities.name: Haste Ward
effects: move speed +30% for 12 s on up to 4 allies
the caster is inside the radius too
abilities.notes: The party haste. It deals no damage: the 30% is flat, it does not scale. Range 0 means the caster's own position and the 12 m radius covers the allies it reaches.

abilities.name: Ward Link
effects: damage taken reduced for 15 s on up to 5 allies
the caster is inside the radius too
abilities.notes: The party shield. It deals no damage: the block carries the damage reduction, on the INT scale, 12 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 18% at L10, 40% at L40. It does not stop a charge from being cancelled, it only stops the party from dying while it is cast.

abilities.name: Hoarfrost Skin
effects: shield absorbs damage before health for 8 s
the shield breaks at 0 and gives no more
abilities.notes: The personal shield, because this class has the lowest health in the game and no self healing. It deals no damage: the block carries the shield, on the INT scale, 130 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 200 at L10. It buys one assassin opener, not two.

abilities.name: Mana Well
effects: mana regen raised for 20 s on up to 4 allies
the caster is inside the radius too
abilities.notes: The mana buff. It deals no damage: the block carries the mana regen per second, on the INT scale, 2 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 3 per second at L10. A caster in the party holds four charges instead of one.

abilities.name: Hush Field
effects: slow 60% for 8 s on anyone inside the decal
the caster is never slowed by its own field
abilities.notes: The wide slow. It deals no damage by design: it is the biggest control in the game and it buys the party 8 s. The decal radius is the spell radius. The caster is never slowed by its own field.

abilities.name: Deep Bind
effects: root 3 s: cannot move or cast
interrupt: cancels a charge in progress
removes one buff from the target
abilities.notes: The capstone hold and the reliable interrupt: it cancels the charge and pins the caster for 3 s while the party hits it. It cannot catch a caster in the last 0.3 s of a charge.

abilities.name: War Edge
effects: weapon damage raised for 25 s on up to 5 allies
attack speed +10% for 25 s
the caster is inside the radius too
abilities.notes: The party weapon buff cap. It deals no damage: the block carries the weapon damage bonus, on the INT scale, 22 x (1 + 0.04 x (INT - 10)): 34% at L10, 73% at L40. Cast it on the clash, not on the walk in: 25 s is long enough for one good trade.

loadout.weapon: short silver focus rod with a gold ring at the tip
loadout.offhand: bone white grimoire bound in gold on a chain

weakness: Lowest health in the game and no self healing: one assassin opener ends the class, and it deals no damage to the timer.
